description: Neovim: plugins install on first start, free Dracula theme, LSP, Telescope search, Markdown and Obsidian notes

hint.linux: Neovim 0.12 or newer; where your distribution's neovim is older: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md

hint.macos: brew install ripgrep (for Telescope's file and text search)
hint.linux: sudo apt install ripgrep (for Telescope's file and text search)

hint.macos: brew install curl (downloads Treesitter parsers and the Markdown preview)
hint.linux: sudo apt install curl (downloads Treesitter parsers and the Markdown preview)

hint.macos: brew install tree-sitter-cli (0.26.1 or newer; builds Treesitter parsers on first start)
hint.linux: tree-sitter 0.26.1 or newer, not from npm (builds Treesitter parsers on first start): https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/releases

hint.macos: xcode-select --install (a C compiler, for tree-sitter to build parsers)
hint.linux: sudo apt install build-essential (a C compiler, for tree-sitter to build parsers)
